memory_candidates.content: In the Kamp NF completeness layer, any hypothesis restricting ALL kvE2_sepPos owners to strict-interior zone classes is inconsistent with honest evaluation: nf_characteristic at (w; w, x, t) is always realized with witness w, forcing a zAtW3-class positive owner (kvE2_sepHonest_hLR_absurd, SharedWitness.lean). Boundary/self-zone classes must be carried by endpoint/pivot literals, never excluded by hypothesis.

IntervalPattern.holds requires strictly monotone per-slot witnesses; full-multiset slot lists over multiple owners admit honest ties (shared realizers, base-value-on-anchor collisions), so joint-bracket completeness needs coincidence-merged slot lists (Rabinovich §5 meet / Def 7.13 union) or a distinct-realizer guarantee.
